record: Source provenance and licence evidence for the RigTale reference cast
purpose: This file is the fixture's licence evidence. It is tracked in Git so that every redistributable artifact under fixtures/ can be shown to have verified provenance and a compatible licence from the repository alone. fixtures/tools/build_cast.py reads its inputs only from inside these archives, and on every build it verifies the archive against the SHA-256 and byte size recorded here, verifies each member it decompresses against the digest recorded for that member, and verifies that the licence text quoted below is still in the archive. Anything that does not match refuses to build, so the bytes this record describes are the bytes the cast was made from.
verified: 2026-08-03, archive and member SHA-256 and byte sizes recomputed from the retrieved archives
generated_sections: Each source's `derives` list is generated by build_cast.py from the members that build actually read and the parts their pixels reached, and `authored_here.parts` is counted the same way. A build whose reads no longer match this file stops and asks for `--update-provenance`, so the list cannot drift from the code.

licence_evidence.location: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Fabric034 and the licensing page it links
licence_evidence.verbatim: The archive ships no licence file, so there is nothing in it to quote. Its ten members are the Color, Displacement, NormalDX, NormalGL and Roughness JPG maps, a preview PNG, and usdc, blend, mtlx and tres material definitions. The CC0 dedication is stated on the source page, and that page is the evidence.

authored_here.note: Original compositions drawn by fixtures/tools/build_cast.py from primitives — generated limbs, the cloud silhouette, clothing bands and their patterns, hair, pigtails, eyes, every mouth state and viseme, the quadruped, the cart and its wheels, the props and every shadow. They derive from no source in this record, and no source in this record is needed to redistribute them.
authored_here.index: cast/manifest.json, parts[].sources. An authored part carries an empty list; a derived part names the archive member its pixels came from.
authored_here.cc0_clean: Both positions are unencumbered. A derived part carries a CC0 dedication forward, and an authored part carries nothing at all, so the cast as a whole is redistributable with no downstream obligation.

excluded: No asset, shape, colour, hair, costume or name is taken from any video reference channel. Channels studied for art direction supplied no asset.
No Adobe sample puppet and no Spine runtime example asset reaches this fixture. Their redistribution rights are not established, so they are read-only references and are not sources here.
Paper001, the Kenney digital audio pack and the other sandbox assets in the local ledger are not used by this fixture, so they are not promoted and are not recorded as sources.
